summary: Tested revamped header navigation for Pigma e-commerce platform. All features working correctly: Desktop header with 3 nav items (All Products, Partner with Us, Sell on Pigma), Amazon-style mega menu on hover showing 6 categories in 4-column grid with gold text, Partner dropdown with 3 links (Influencer→/creators, Affiliate→/affiliate, Reseller→/reseller-register), Sell on Pigma gold CTA navigating to /vendor-login. Mobile responsive hamburger menu with expandable categories and Partner section. User dropdown menu working for logged-in users with Admin Dashboard option for admin role.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: Clean implementation with MegaMenu, PartnerDropdown, MobileMenu components
Header.jsx: Categories fetched dynamically via /api/categories on mount
Header.jsx: Hover intent helpers (openMega/closeMega) with 150ms timeout prevent flicker
Header.jsx: PartnerDropdownPortal uses fixed positioning with bounding rect calculation
Header.jsx: Mobile drawer uses z-[61] with backdrop z-[60] for proper layering
Header.jsx: All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
category_routes.py: GET /api/categories returns only active categories with sub_categories
